UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile, model preferences, voice configuration, and memory consent settings.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

preferredModel.description: Default Gemini model ID for conversations.

memoryPermissionGranted.description: Whether Jarvis AI has permission to store persistent memories.

autoSpeakResponses.description: Whether Jarvis automatically reads AI responses aloud.

wakeWordEnabled.description: Whether hands-free Jarvis wake-phrase standby is enabled in Voice Mode.

systemInstructions.description: Custom persona or response instructions provided by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was last updated.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A persistent AI conversation thread owned by a user.

modelId.description: Gemini model used for this thread.

lastMessagePreview.description: Preview of the most recent message.

messageCount.description: Number of messages in this conversation.

pinned.description: Whether conversation is pinned to the top.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when conversation was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of the latest activity.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single message turn inside a conversation.

text.description: Markdown text content of the message.

attachmentType.description: Type of multimodal attachment sent with this message.

attachmentName.description: Display filename of any attached document or image.

generatedImageFile.description: Local filename for any AI-generated image associated with this turn.

modelUsed.description: Gemini model name that generated this reply.

isError.description: True if this message represents an API or timeout error.

clientOrder.description: Monotonic client sequence timestamp for deterministic ordering.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when message was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when message was last updated.

MemoryEntry.title: MemoryEntry
MemoryEntry.description: Persistent memory fact, preference, or project context saved for Jarvis AI.

sourceConversationId.description: Optional conversation ID where this memory originated.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when memory was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when memory was updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile and Jarvis AI preferences isolated per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/conversations/{conversat.description: Messages belonging to a user's conversation thread.

/users/{userId}/memories/{memoryId}.description: Persistent user memories managed with explicit user consent.
